IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Rockefeller, Nixon, Haigh, Morris, Jarrett, Campbell and McDermott

Bill.BriefDescription: Prescribing license fees for small trailers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to small trailer fees; amending RCW 46.16.0621;adding a new section to chapter 46.16 RCW; and providing an effectivedate.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.16.0621 and 2002 c 352 s 7 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) License tab fees shall be thirty dollars per year for allvehicles. (2) For the purposes of this section, "license tab fees" aredefined as the general fees paid annually for licensing motor vehiclesand trailers as defined in RCW 46.04.620 and 46.04.623. Trailerslicensed under RCW 46.16.068 or 46.16.085 or as provided for in section2 of this act and campers licensed under RCW 46.16.505 are not requiredto pay license tab fees under this section.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText:
(1) In lieu of the fees provided in RCW 46.16.0621, trailers ofless than one thousand five hundred pounds gross weight and used for p. 1 HB 1452noncommercial, personal use on the public highways, may be licensedupon the payment of a license fee according to the following weightschedule:
Under 200 poundsno fee
200 499 pounds$5.00
500 999 pounds$10.00
1000 1499 pounds$20.00
